The structure of Tb₂Mg₁₂Cd₂ (reduced formula TbMg₆Cd) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Cd, Mg, and Tb centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing in the computed periodic contact patterns. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. No property labels were supplied for this description.
